name: OOO Works – AI Visibility and Website Check
author: oooworks

sections.description:
More customers now ask an AI assistant (“which plumber in Austin would you recommend?”) instead of searching. This plugin shows, in plain words, whether those assistants can read your site and what to fix. It’s free, needs no account, and sends nothing anywhere until you press a check button.

Four free checks (Tools > OOO Works):

  • Can AI assistants read your site? Robots.txt rules and what your server answers for each AI crawler: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot and Bing, Siri, Alexa, DuckDuckGo and Mistral. One line per assistant (OK, blocked, or can’t tell), with the fix and the robots.txt lines to use. It also tells you where your robots.txt comes from on WordPress: a real file on the server, WordPress’s own virtual robots.txt, or your SEO plugin.
  • Website check. A score out of 100 for the basics customers and search engines look for (secure connection, phones, contact details, page titles, business details), each with a plain-word fix.
  • Search result and link preview. How your home page may look in Google and when someone shares a link (title, description, Open Graph image), with fixes.
  • Sitemap. Finds your sitemap (WordPress’s /wp-sitemap.xml or your SEO plugin’s), checks it, and opens up to 20 listed pages for errors, redirects, noindex and canonical tags pointing elsewhere.

Two fixes the plugin can make for you. Both are off until you turn them on, show you exactly what they’ll do first, and come with one-click Undo:

  • Let AI search crawlers in. Adds one group to the robots.txt WordPress makes, allowing the crawlers AI assistants use to search and to open pages people ask about (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User and others). It only adds lines: it never removes a rule, leaves alone any crawler your robots.txt already names, and keeps your “User-agent: *” restrictions. AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended) are not included; that’s your choice. If your site has a real robots.txt file, an SEO plugin with its own robots.txt editor (Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress), is installed in a sub-folder, or asks search engines not to index it, the plugin explains what to do instead of adding anything.
  • Business details for search engines and AI. A short form (name, type of business, address, phone, opening hours, services, area, profiles) that adds LocalBusiness structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) to your home page, the same as OOO Works’ free business schema generator. If Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework or Slim SEO is active, it doesn’t add a second description of your business; it tells you to fill in your details there.

Optional: does AI recommend your business? Enter your business name, trade and town, press “Ask AI now”, and the plugin shows whether Google’s Gemini (with Google Search) names your business when asked three questions a customer would type, who it names instead, and which sites the answers relied on. It runs only when you press the button.

Optional weekly check. Off by default. When you switch it on, the four free checks run once a week and the page shows what changed since the check before.

Checking a staging or local copy? The checks open your site from the internet, like a visitor. Set “Site to check” to your public address.

Limits

The checks are free and limited per server address: 30 checks an hour, and 3 AI answer checks a day. Websites on shared hosting share their server’s address, so other sites on the same server count towards the same limit. The plugin keeps results for 30 days, doesn’t send the same check again within 10 minutes (the service caches results that long), reuses AI answer results for the same business for 24 hours, and waits 15 minutes before asking again after the service says “too many checks”.

External services

This plugin connects to OOO Works (https://oooworks.com), the service that runs the checks. Nothing is sent until an administrator presses a button on the plugin’s page, or switches on the weekly check.

OOO Works checks API (https://oooworks.com/api/)

  • What it’s for: the four free checks (AI crawler access, website check, search and link preview, sitemap).
  • When: each time an administrator presses a check button (or “Run all four checks”), and once a week for each of the four checks if the administrator switched on the weekly check.
  • What is sent: the address of the site to check (this site’s home page address, or the “Site to check” setting). Requests go to https://oooworks.com/api/ai-crawler-check, /api/website-check, /api/preview-check and /api/sitemap-check. Like any web request, it also reveals your server’s IP address; OOO Works uses it only to apply the rate limits above and doesn’t store it. The plugin’s requests don’t include WordPress’s usual user agent with your site’s address.
  • What OOO Works does: it keeps each result in memory for 10 minutes so a repeat check is instant, writes no address or IP address to disk, and opens the public pages of that address from its own servers (home page, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, a contact page and up to 20 pages listed in the sitemap) and sends the result back.

OOO Works AI answer check, using Google’s Gemini API (https://oooworks.com/api/ai-answer-check)

  • What it’s for: the optional “Does AI recommend your business?” panel.
  • When: only when an administrator presses “Ask AI now”. Never on a schedule.
  • What is sent: the business name, trade, town or city and country the administrator typed, and the host name of the site to check (for example example.com). OOO Works sends questions built from these (for example “I’m looking for a good plumber in Austin. Which ones would you recommend?”) to Google’s Gemini API with Google Search, and returns the answers. The site address is used only to recognise your own pages among the sites the answers cite.
  • OOO Works keeps the result in memory for 24 hours so the same business gets the same answers, and doesn’t write your details to disk.
  • Google’s terms: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.

Traffic to oooworks.com passes through Cloudflare (Cloudflare privacy policy).

OOO Works: about OOO Works, contact and terms. OOO Works’ privacy policy will be published on oooworks.com; until then, the about page is the contact for any privacy question.

Links to OOO Works’ free services. The plugin’s page shows one panel (which you can hide) linking to OOO Works’ free weekly watch and AI visibility preview on app.oooworks.com. Nothing is sent to OOO Works unless you open those links yourself.

Privacy

  • The plugin adds nothing to your visitors’ pages except the business details you choose to add (structured data on the home page). No cookies, no tracking, no analytics, no ads.
  • Results are stored in your WordPress database (as transients) and removed when you delete the plugin.
  • The plugin adds a suggested paragraph to Settings > Privacy for your privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New (search “OOO Works”), or upload the zip, and activate it.
  2. Open Tools > OOO Works.
  3. Press “Run all four checks”. If your site isn’t public yet (staging or local), enter your public address under “Site to check” first.
sections.faq:
Is it free? Do I need an account?

Yes, and no. Every feature of the plugin works without an account or payment. Nothing is for sale.

Will the robots.txt fix change my existing rules?

No. It only adds a group for AI search crawlers your robots.txt doesn’t already name, after showing you the exact lines, and Undo removes them. It doesn’t edit a robots.txt file on your server.

Why didn’t the plugin add my business details?

Your SEO plugin already describes your site or business in its structured data, and two separate descriptions confuse search engines. Fill in your business details in your SEO plugin instead.

The check says it couldn’t open my site

The checks run from the internet. A local or staging site, a site behind a password or “coming soon” page, or a firewall that blocks unknown visitors can’t be checked. Enter your public address under “Site to check”.

It says I’ve used my checks for now

Checks are limited per server address. On shared hosting, many websites share one address, so others may have used the limit. Wait a little and try again; results already shown stay on the page.

Can AI answers be guaranteed?

No. Nobody controls what an AI assistant says. The AI answer check measures what one assistant said at one moment; answers change from day to day.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • robots.txt fallback reads the admin and Ajax paths from admin_url() instead of assuming /wp-admin/.
  • Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org; no translation files are bundled.

1.0.0

  • First release: AI crawler, website, preview and sitemap checks; robots.txt allow group for AI search crawlers; LocalBusiness structured data; optional AI answer check; optional weekly check; Korean translation.
